summary: Harrison County, TX lookout relocated to Winston Ranch in Nacogdoches County; listed as standing, but the move date and mover are not in the sources read.

events.note: Survey description of the Elysian Fields tower: 100 feet overall, glass-enclosed cab on a four-legged steel frame, painted gray
Recovery note: a new tower was to be built a few feet west of the present one. Not confirmed whether it was built.
Moved from Elysian Fields to Winston Ranch. No date or mover appears in the sources read.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two sources. The 1958 and 1963 descriptions are of the original Elysian Fields site, not of the Winston Ranch tower, and the sources do not say which structure was moved. The agency fact is the Texas Forest Service named beside the National Geodetic Survey in the survey page's header; the page does not state ownership, and the story words it that way. Both the FFLA list and our record spell the county Nacagdoches; the correct spelling is Nacogdoches (Wikipedia), so the correction is proposed for human review. The TSHA Elysian Fields town entry was read and has no lookout mention. Winston Ranch owner, access and condition were not found; the search returned no other source for this tower.
